api: lightgbm.train on one shared Dataset per worker, set_label per label; parameters 1:1 with LGBMClassifier via PerLabelScalePosLGBM (parity recorded in results/eda.json)
split_strategy: within-user temporal: train t=n_u-2, val t=n_u-1, test t=n_u (eval_set=='train' order)

label_set.rule: products with >= min_pos positives in the train basis rows; capped at max_labels by frequency
label_set.reason: compute budget: 9035 products satisfy min_pos=20, kept the 4000 most frequent
